purpose: Third independent scoped standard-caller task/effect sample after R03/R04; not a reliability estimate, MAP01 run, or efficiency comparison.
hypothesis: A fresh, uniquely identified Win32 fixture can receive one standard supervised-win32 A key chord, return verified release, remain neutral throughout the 2 s late-input horizon, and independently record the task effect after the 6 s fixture delay.
treatment: One public MCP observe/dispatch/results/close sequence through runtime.cli_v1.mcp_server; exact program is focus, one A key_chord, release_all. No replay. One independent task-effect poll after terminal, for at most 12 s.
target_gate: Create a fresh run-owned fixture, require exactly one CUA window titled Agent Interface Win32 Fixture, activate that returned window, and independently verify foreground PID/HWND/title match before invoking the public caller. Stop before dispatch on any mismatch or stale/changed generation.

release_and_late_input.required: release_confirmed=true and independent neutral state from the public caller receipt

stop_rules: Never dispatch if foreground identity or observation generation is not exact and fresh.
If the one action remains unresolved at its finite deadline, cancel once, continue observation to terminal, and do not replay.
Close only the exact run-owned fixture after terminal custody is retained.
Preserve FAIL_OR_UNKNOWN if release or effect cannot be independently confirmed.
